title: FQuake
wikitext:
'''fQuake''' is the sequel to [[eQuake]], which was the first All-In-One QuakeWorld package to hit it big within the QuakeWorld scene. Nowadays [[NQuake|nQuake]] is probably the best choice for any QuakeWorld player who doesn't explicitly want fQuake. == Latest versions == * '''Windows:''' [http://downloads.sourceforge.net/fquake/fquake14_installer.exe 1.4]
* '''Linux:''' [http://downloads.sourceforge.net/fquake/fquake-linux-i386-2.27.tar.gz 2.27] == Contributors == * '''Windows installer, concept, website & putting it all together:''' [[Empezar]] * '''Linux installer:''' [[i0h]] * '''Mirror providers:''' [[i0h]], [[Spirit]], [[mescon]], [[deurk]], [[zergie]] For more credits, see [http://fquake.sf.net/credits.html fQuake credits]. == External Links == * [http://sf.net/projects/fquake/ Project website] * [http://fquake.sf.net/ Official website] * [http://fquake.sf.net/getstarted.html Online manual] [[Category:Packages]]
